title: Sleepy Don" outdoes "Sleepy Joe
text:
Sleepy Don" outdoes "Sleepy Joe""

"- After new footage of Trump dozing off during an official meeting were released, critics, referencing the nickname "Sleepy Joe" that he uses for Biden, dubbed him "Sleepy Don.""

"- Ansari, a Democratic member of the U.S. House of Representatives, also reacted to this moment, writing: "He falls asleep at work almost every day. This is a national security crisis!""

"- Recently, the Governor of Illinois once again expressed concern about Trump's health, stating that the U.S. President is suffering from dementia.
